title: Parts of cigarette lighters and other lighters (except flints and wicks); pyrophoric alloys; articles of combustible materials n.e.c.

review.classification: The original UN leaf and the HS 9613.90 subset agree with the first-party customs ruling on the specifically identified passive end cap. The scope excludes complete products whether filled or empty, decorated sleeves and shipping or presentation boxes.
review.primary_evidence: N334329 is a government decision on a specific commercial applicant’s described spare part. Its prospective import language does not establish an actual entry, separately released batch, resin grade, site or mass. Comparison decisions distinguish constituent parts and packaging. Confirm the actual product identity, period, independent standalone supplier-release history and relevant jurisdiction for a study.
review.native_records: The broad CPC-derived native parts flow does not establish the selected end-cap material, functional identity or first release. The corrugated board box record explicitly specifies a type of box; its supplier-specific composition and occurrence need independent evidence. Mass and Energy support units only. The archived Goods transport (mass*distance) property explicitly points to Units of mass*length, whose reference is t*km and whose kg*km conversion factor is 0.001. This verifies transport-work units independently of the carrier, vehicle, load and service inventory.
review.readiness: Candidate/authored methodology only. Require original eligible batch, net mass and actual component specifications, separate packaging, supplier environmental coverage and local activity before using results. Scientific and independent translation approval and publication remain pending.

review.measurement: Controller checked two independent status ledgers in kg. Unreleased opening 3 plus eligible receipts 12 equals first released 7, closing 4, waste 1 and genuine unreleased outward transfer 3. Released opening 5 plus the same 7, returned old lots 2 and other already-released receipts 3 equals all outward product transfers 13, closing 3 and separately sent waste 1. The 7 kg status transfer cancels in the combined perimeter. The author supplied the missing Tu and If interfaces, removed the ambiguous extra outbound term, independently checked a different numerical example and separated subsequent services at zero current production from the original positive release cohort. Both packaging materials and their original burden vectors have separate ledgers. Illustrative mass bridge only: 100 eligible items in one measured 2 g stratum and 50 in a separate measured 3 g stratum yield 0.350 kg, whereas applying their unweighted mean to 150 items yields 0.375 kg. Tie piece counts and their measurements to the same original release cohort. No quantity or material parameter in this check is an observation of the commercial product.

sources.role: Original CBP Decision N334329 (August 9, 2023). The described replacement cap is classified under 9613.90.8000 when separately imported; a complete empty lighter falls elsewhere. Prospective ruling, limited to the product description and facts filed.
UNSD 2026 supplemental CPC3 row 1853. HS 9613.90 covers the parts subset of CPC 38995. The residual CPC coordinate also includes products outside this method.
USITC 2023 HTSA Revision 10, Chapter 96 PDF p. 10; the statistical unit is No. on 9613.90.80.00. Distinguish customs piece count from net kg of an original released lot.
CBP NY M82869 (April 24, 2006) assigns decorative fitted cases for an already-complete lighter to chapter 79. Negative comparator only.
CBP NY I88260 (November 14, 2002): separately imported plastic gift box classified as packing under heading 3923. Its mass and purpose differ from the reference part.
European Commission PEF Annex I provides general inventory, measurement, packaging and allocation context.
